action_scope: A categorical choice selects a local region around a qualified geometry anchor or a full original-domain exploration region; a continuous residual selects the requested shot inside it. All region interiors are unqualified. Requested actions still receive fresh IK/FK/path proxies and measured native release gates. Global exploration is not an extra qualified anchor, and unresolved sites are not proven impossible. Arm travel and initialized ball release remain scripted, not learned motor/grasp control.

geometry_preparation.cost_scope: Geometry preprocessing is additional to the matched native shot budget. Native elapsed includes setup, filming and evaluation; this is not a matched headless compute benchmark.

report.description: Additive display normalization only: maximum_resident_set_kib aliases the original max_rss_kib. Original receipt bytes remain unchanged. GNU time process peak RSS is not aggregate worker memory; excludes original map/native calibration/pilot cost.
report.scope: CPU-only preparation for153localregions+33globaldomains; maximumRSS is GNUtime process metric, not aggregate8worker memory. Excludes original17920request map and native calibration/pilot cost.

support.scope: Geometry-only union of all canonical-home-path-qualified map anchors and fixed continuous residual boxes plus one full-domain exploration region per supported cell. The full domain is unqualified; its first local anchor is a warm start only. No capture labels, reward selection, projection, resampling or probe-based shrinkage. Geometry assists known held-out coordinates; not globally unseen-context inference or collision-certified region interiors.

support.selection: Every map candidate passing unchanged canonical-home path proxy plus one unqualified original-domain escape region per supported context; no outcome-dependent pruning
